questions.question: In the early church in Jerusalem, the Grecian Jews grumbled about the daily food distribution. What was their complaint?

answers.text: Their homes were too far from the temple
Their language was left out of the prayers

questions.question: To fix the problem with food for the widows, how many men did the apostles ask the disciples to choose?
When men from the Synagogue of the Freedmen argued with Stephen in Jerusalem, what happened?

answers.text: They could not stand up to his wisdom
They trapped him with a question of law
They left without saying a word

questions.question: When the Sanhedrin looked closely at Stephen as he stood accused, what did they see in his face?
